credits.lost: running, but the process is gone — run again
credits.title: Credits
credits.rowTitle: Jobs on API credits: list, run, accept and reject
credits.topupNote: In the last 5 days before a grant expires, Kermach runs the queue itself until a $5 reserve is left. The load flag pauses it.
credits.fCheck: How to check — command (for an agent)
credits.empty: No jobs. “Add job” above or the command kermach credits add.
credits.pkName: Batch name — the results folder gets this name
credits.pkSrcLines: List of lines: one line — one request
credits.pkFiles: Files: mask from the project folder, e.g. docs/*.md (comma-separated)
credits.pkCardQ: Number or words of the title — Enter
credits.pkLines: Or lines: each line is a separate request
credits.pkRecipe: Recipe — fills in the wizard, you can edit the text
credits.pkInstrHint: One instruction for all requests, placed at the start of each — the server caches it. Your own recipes are .md files in the project’s .kermach\batch\recipes\.
credits.pkEffortHint: How deeply the model thinks. Thinking counts toward the answer length: on high the limit runs out sooner
credits.pkEffHigh: Effort: high — thinks long, needs a bigger limit
credits.pkThinkHint: Claude 5 models think first, and thinking counts toward the answer length. Too small a limit cuts the answer short or leaves it empty. The worst-case price counts the whole limit.
credits.pkRevLimit: Answer limit: {mt} tokens including the model's thinking, effort {e}. The worst case counts the whole limit.
credits.pkWebHint: up to 5 searches per request, $0.01 per search — no batch discount
credits.pkFetchHint: up to 5 pages per request, up to 20,000 tokens each — counted as input
credits.pkCodeHint: Anthropic sandbox: 1,550 hours a month free, then $0.05 per hour — not in the estimate
credits.pkRevFetch: From pages — up to {n} in the worst case.
credits.pkRevPrice: About {typ}. Worst case {worst}: every answer at full length, no cache.
credits.pkNoPriceWarn: Model {m} is not in the price table — the sum cannot be estimated. Sending only with your confirmation.
credits.pkOver: Worst-case price {worst} is above the limit {th}. Sending only with confirmation of the sum.
credits.pkToAnthropicLines: These lines will be sent to the Anthropic server:
credits.pkToAnthropic: These files will be sent to the Anthropic server:
credits.pkSecretHead: Skipped as secret — will not be sent:
credits.pkEmpty: No batches. A batch is many requests in one order at half price; the answer usually comes within an hour.
credits.pkNeedName: Enter a batch name in step 1
credits.rcpSummaryText: What this file is about — in five lines. No introduction, only the point: what it contains and what it is for.
credits.rcpReview: Review against a list of rules
credits.rcpReviewText:
Check the file against the rules below. For each violation write a line “violation — line number — why”. No violations — answer “none”.

Rules:
1. …
2. …
credits.rcpResearchText: Each line is a question or a website address. Find the answer on the web and read the pages you need. Answer briefly, with links to the sources.
credits.rcpCardsText: Check the card against the rules of a good card. Answer as a list: where “How to check” is vague, where files are not named, where the card is too big and should be split. All good — answer “no remarks”.
